## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

Reflation bias: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%) and DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +7.06%) showing clear strength; GLD in CORRECTION (1W: -4.19% | 1M: +1.68%) — divergent precious metals flows.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE RECOVERY (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.25%) while BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -2.98%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -19.40%) show weakness in oil/gas exposures.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed reflation tilt: CPER and DBB ABOVE TREND. MAJOR Divergence present across SPY (CORRECTION), XLK (CORRECTION) and XLF (CORRECTION) — momentum mixed, so suppress strong directional bets and treat moves as transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor commodity and selected EM exposures: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%), DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.64% | 1M: +7.06%), EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.74% | 1M: +2.23%); reduce exposure to speculative growth: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.46% | 1M: -0.79%), QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.25% | 1M: -0.34%), XLK CORRECTION (1W: -1.36% | 1M: +0.71%); monitor HYG/LQD and VXX for credit/fear repricing.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals (CPER ABOVE TREND 1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%), base metals (DBB ABOVE TREND 1W: +2.64% | 1M: +7.06%). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.96% | 1M: -19.40%) and selective softs/weats showing pressure.

VXX ~26.47 (1W: -2.18% | 1M: -16.50%) — complacency threshold; Credit Spread 0.7317 (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND — watch for widening; XLK/XLF ratio 2.6286 (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -4.17%) RECOVERY — style pivot marker.

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -17.44%) ↓ falling but credit spread 0.7317 ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.41% | 1M: +0.75%) ↑ rising — mixed signals. Commodities and EM showing relative strength (CPER ABOVE TREND 1W: +2.37% | 1M: +8.27%; EEM ABOVE TREND 1W: +0.74% | 1M: +2.23%). Key risk is the MAJOR divergence across SPY, XLK and XLF (all in CORRECTION); monitor HYG/LQD and VXX for a directional resolution.
